_about: Editorial Collage: a calm, premium talking-head template. Collage pages (an engraving on every page, CRT screen look) land on the speaker's own words; hook page at 2-4 s; name tag from the first frame until the hook page; number cards, logo tiles, object pop-ups; one type slam per video; condensed serif captions in a phrase-sized box that fill in word by word; face-centred framing; rich grade; opening burn in the brand colour; a lo-fi bed with drops before the payoff and the call to action; a quiet paper/pen/zoom sound layer. Brand-neutral: colours, watermark and name tag come from the brand kit. R1b port note: `openFlash.clip` ('burn-04.mp4', from library/packs/editorsinventory/) is dropped, same as alif.json - this fork has no library/packs/ yet (decision 4 / E1, separate task) and pickBurn() dies on a missing file; without `clip` it falls back to the asset-free CSS-gradient flash (packClip() returns null gracefully when packs/ is absent). `music` is null here, not main's 'alif-match-a' - that id only exists in main's library/music/manifest.json, a Mixkit track this port deliberately does not bring over (BRANCH-AUDIT.md decision 4), same as alif.json.

director.style: A calm, premium founder interview. The speaker carries the reel; editorial PAGES (paper cut-aways) carry the ideas. Emphasis never comes from caption effects.
director.hook: The FIRST page lands 2-4 s in, on the hook line's key phrase (e.g. 'implementing AI ... completely wrong', 'save you a lot of money'). It is a pattern break that holds the viewer. The name tag is on screen from the first frame until that first page cuts in ( name 0-2 s, first page at 2 s); never move the name tag later than the first 0.3 s.
director.pages: About one page every 10-15 s, 1.6-3 s each, never two in a row without the speaker between them. Each page = 2-4 short lines in the speaker's own words + ONE engraving that says what the idea IS (money -> moneybag/coins, time -> watch/hourglass, systems/workflow -> gears, AI/tools -> robot, an idea -> lightbulb, thinking/expertise -> brain, finding problems -> magnifier, ask/point at people -> hand, strategy/plan -> chess, getting started -> ladder). A page with no picture is not allowed.
director.page_lines: Line styles: 'serif' (plain lead-in words), 'box' (THE key phrase, brand box, exactly one per page), 'caps' (tiny condensed caps for a connector like 'of automations'), 'marker' (handwritten aside: a question the viewer asks, a contrast 'not another AI tool', or a verdict 'completely wrong'). Each line lands ON the spoken word (use its start time). A marker line spoken first opens the page at the top. Every line is words spoken WHILE the page is on screen; never put words on a page that were said before it appeared (it reads as lagging the voice).
director.cutaway_timing: A page starts on the first stressed word of a new phrase, never mid-word, and ends on a phrase boundary.
director.automatic: Do NOT plan these, the engine does them: numbered pop-ups on 'number one / secondly / step two', logo tiles when a tool is named, object pop-ups (an engraving card + the spoken word on a brand label) when a concrete thing is named between pages (day-to-day -> calendar, time -> watch, money -> coins, emails -> envelope, team -> people, growth -> chart) (ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, DeepSeek, Zapier...), punch-in cadence, captions, sound design (paper-in, pen ticks, object sounds, zoom swishes, burns + whooshes, lo-fi bed with drops before the last page and the call to action), colour matching, the opening flash.
director.nametag: name + company in the box + a one-line 'what I do for you' (e.g. 'AI Implementation for Businesses').
director.restraint: Keep the speaker on screen most of the time. Quiet sound, few effects, each one meaning something.
director.virality: From the outlier study (engine/templates/VIRALITY.md): the hook is the viewer's own question or a specific, named situation (tool, number, real client), said in the first 2 s and shown as on-screen text in frame 1; never an intro, never a platitude. Cut intros anywhere in the video ('I'm right here in...', 'today I'm going to show you...') when they delay the content. Keep 6+ picture changes in the first 10 s.
director.slam: Once per video, on the most charged word (a verdict, a money/time word, a call to action like 'start building'): a 'slam' beat, 1.4-2 s, one huge word (text) with an optional small line above (pre) or below (post), landing on the word as it is spoken.
